# Files rsync must NEVER push or delete during a deploy.
#
# This matters because the deploy uses --delete to keep production identical
# to the repo. Anything that lives only on the server and is not listed here
# WILL BE DELETED on the next deploy. When you add a file that production
# generates at runtime, add it here first.

# Repository plumbing
.git/
.github/

# Secrets: real values live on the server, injected by systemd
*.env

# Irreplaceable data: user uploads and databases
uploads/
*.db
*.db-journal
# SQLite WAL mode writes these two beside the database. They are NOT
# matched by *.db, and a deploy landing while a checkpoint is pending
# would delete un-checkpointed writes.
*.db-wal
*.db-shm
*.sqlite
*.sqlite3

# Database backups: note *.db does NOT match challenge.db.20260823.bak
*.bak
*.backup

# Runtime state: sockets, logs, caches the app writes itself
*.sock
*.ctl
*.log
cache/
.download_cache/

# Rebuildable dependencies
venv/
.venv/
node_modules/
__pycache__/
*.pyc

# Repository documentation. Nothing in production reads it, and on a static
# site it would be publicly fetchable at /CLAUDE.md.
CLAUDE.md
